newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan firms build environment friendly incinerator.
newsitem.headline: Japan firms build environment friendly incinerator.

text.p: Fuji Heavy Industries Ltd said on Wednesday that it, Teisan KK and two other Japanese firms had developed an environmentally friendly and cost-effective garbage incineration plant.
The dioxin emissions level from the new plant will meet new government guidelines to be set up later this year, a Fuji Heavy spokesman said.
Ashes from the incinerator are non-toxic and can be recycled as construction material, he said.
The plant would trim fuel, labour and maintenance costs, he said.
Fuji Heavy's other two partners are Tomen Construction Co Ltd, which is 100 percent owned by trading house Tomen Corp, and Ogihara Ecology Co Ltd,
Dioxin is a highly toxic by-product of some industrial processes and is known to cause a wide range of diseases, including cancer.
